conclusion: Both readers independently checked the defining guide, older vendor guides, linked planner/input/instrument material and official TT Set A CSV. The bead TSO, final product and index table are source-backed. Related same-kit CG000734/735 and intermediate predecessor CG000331 have only a first pass here; missing current-kit RT primer and adapter claims remain blocked. Both source passes also identify the same cDNA Primers PN-2000089 in the current kit and in a predecessor appendix that prints its primer bases; this is catalog-linked evidence, not a direct current-kit oligo table.
